images.alt: Black-and-white photo of a misty gravel road through a forest; a green cartoon troll in a loincloth lurks at the roadside while cartoon Gravel God, handlebar mustache, rides toward the camera.

images.name: hitchhiker
images.alt: Cartoon Gravel God, seen from behind, stands at the edge of a long dirt road through the trees, a car's headlights far in the distance.

images.name: hourglass
images.alt: Cartoon Gravel God, handlebar mustache, in profile, stares at an antique brass hourglass with sand running from the top bulb.

images.name: shit-on-cycling
images.alt: Cartoon Gravel God, handlebar mustache, stands by a bicycle propped against a stained wall, watching a white dog squat to relieve itself on the pavement.

images.name: pyramid
images.alt: The pyramids of Giza under a blue sky, a camel caravan crossing the sand in front, with a tiny cartoon Gravel God in a white tee walking his bicycle among the camels.
